title: Orbit-quotient curriculum for compositional generalization
summary: Train on one canonical representative per known transformation orbit, then measure generalization to held-out representatives and unseen orbit compositions.
hypothesis: An orbit-aware curriculum will improve held-out composition accuracy by at least 4 percentage points over a data-volume-matched random curriculum.
novelty: The experiment tests the useful lesson from classification theory: factor regular symmetry families out of the data before spending capacity on genuine exceptions.
